page: Google Cloud Platform z4d-highmem-96-highlssd is a virtual machine belonging to the z4d server family. It is configured with 96 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 CPU architecture. The system features 756.0 GB of system memory, which equates to approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per core. There are no GPUs associated with this server configuration, and the local storage size is designated as None in the primary specifications, although the basic description references twelve local SSDs.

This server type provides a high density of memory relative to its compute resources, positioning it as a memory-optimized resource. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention from neighboring virtual machines. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory-to-vCPU ratio makes this instance suitable for workloads requiring large in-memory datasets, reducing the need to scale out to larger, more expensive clusters.

The hardware profile of the z4d-highmem-96-highlssd is suited for memory-intensive applications. Appropriate workloads include large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, heavy data analytics, and memory-bound scientific simulations.
